texts.zh: 我们成功骇进了[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的网络系统，并获取了他们数据库的权限一段时间。尽管我们利用权限进行操作没有持续多久，我们依然对大批量的数据进行了拷贝并且希望——它不仅能帮助我们迅速破解对方的语言，也能评估对方的科技水准。
texts.en: We were successfully able to hack into the network systems of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] and gained access to their databanks for a time. Although our period of access was brief, we were able to make copies of a considerable body of data that should - hopefully - help us not only swiftly translate their language but also assess their technological level.

texts.zh: 我们成功骇进了[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的网络系统，并获取了他们数据库的权限一段时间。然后我们的权限就突然中断了——显然，我们的骇客行为被发现了。尽管我们利用权限进行操作没有持续多久，我们依然对大批量的数据进行了拷贝并且希望——它不仅能帮助我们迅速破解对方的语言，也能评估对方的科技水准。我们只能希望不要因为玩了这个小把戏，对方就把我们当作危险的敌人。
texts.en: We were successfully able to hack into the network systems of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] and gained access to their databanks for a time, before our access was abruptly cut off - evidently, our presence did not go undetected. Although our period of access was brief, we were able to make copies of a considerable body of data that should - hopefully - help us not only swiftly translate their language but also assess their technological level. We can only hope that we haven't made ourselves dangerous enemies with this ploy...

tooltips.en: The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have gained a poor first impression of us.

texts.zh: 我们负责研究[From.Owner.GetName]的团队报告了令人警觉的消息：他们试图骇入我们的电脑系统，但是被发现了！不幸的是，在我们切断他们权限之前，他们已经获得权限接触了体量相当庞大的敏感信息。这一不友好的行为让相当多位于[Root.Owner.GetName]的人表示了担忧，认为[From.Owner.GetName]可能会造成威胁。
texts.en: Our team in charge of researching the [From.Owner.GetName] report alarming news: an attempt by them to hack into our computer systems has been detected! Unfortunately, it seems that they gained access to a considerable amount of sensitive information before we were able to shut off their access. This unfriendly act has left many within the [Root.Owner.GetName] deeply worried at the threat the [From.Owner.GetName] may pose.

texts.zh: 我们负责研究[From.Owner.GetName]的子个体报告了令人警觉的消息：他们试图骇入我们的电脑系统，但是被发现了！不幸的是，在我们切断他们权限之前，他们已经获得权限，接触了体量相当庞大的敏感信息。我们会紧盯着他们，他们在未来做出任何对[This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]有损的事情，我们都能在第一时间注意到。
texts.en: Our drones in charge of researching the [From.Owner.GetName] report alarming news: an attempt by them to hack into our computer systems has been detected! Unfortunately, it seems that they gained access to a considerable amount of sensitive information before we were able to shut off their access. We should be watchful of them, and be wary of any future moves they may make that could be detrimental to the [This.Owner.GetGovernmentName].

texts.zh: 我们负责研究[From.Owner.GetName]的无人机报告了令人警觉的消息：他们试图骇入我们的电脑系统，但是被发现了！不幸的是，在我们切断他们权限之前，他们已经获得权限接触了体量相当庞大的敏感信息。这一偶然事件督促我们应当尽快更新防御协议和机动系统防火墙——同时也不要忘了上调[From.Owner.GetName]的威胁等级。
texts.en: Our drones in charge of researching the [From.Owner.GetName] report alarming news: an attempt by them to hack into our systems has been detected! Unfortunately, it seems that they gained access to a considerable amount of sensitive information before we were able to shut off their access. This occurrence has prompted us to update our defense protocols and mobile systems' firmware - and to upgrade our threat rating of the [From.Owner.GetName].

label.zh: 我们要小心点盯着他们。
label.en: We will have to be watchful of them.

texts.zh: 我们试图潜入[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的网络系统找出有关他们的更多信息，这一尝试没有成功。[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]以及[This.Leader.GetHerHis]的科研团队迅速认识到，他们与之对抗的系统过于先进——抑或是他们的监视者太警觉——根本没法用现有的方式找出漏洞。幸运的是，[This.Leader.GetSheHe][This.Leader.GetWasWere]在被对方探查到之前就及时终止了骇客任务。
texts.en: Our attempts to covertly delve into the network systems of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] to find out more about them have been unsuccessful. [This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] and [This.Leader.GetHerHis] science team quickly realized that the systems they were up against were simply too advanced - or their overseers too vigilant - to be caught out in this manner. Fortunately, [This.Leader.GetSheHe] [This.Leader.GetWasWere] able to abort their hacking attempt before it was detected.

label.zh: 那么，我们就需要动用强硬手段了。
label.en: We will have to do this the hard way, then.

texts.zh: 看来，我们试图潜入[This.ContactCountry.GetName]网络系统的行为被发现了。目前暂且不知道哪一步出了差错，但是[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]宣称他们面对的系统实在是太先进了——抑或是他们的监视者太警觉了——他们根本无法通过现有的手段找出漏洞。不幸的是，等他们认识到这一点的时候，一切都太晚了。我们只能希望，我们不会因为这点小把戏就被当成危险的敌人……
texts.en: It appears that our attempts to covertly delve into the network systems of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] were detected. It is not clear exactly what went wrong, but [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] claims that the systems they were up against were simply too advanced - or their overseers too vigilant - to be caught out in this manner. Unfortunately, by the time this became clear, it was too late. We can only hope that we haven't made ourselves dangerous enemies with this ploy...

tooltips.en: The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have gained a poor first impression of us.

texts.zh: 我们负责研究[From.Owner.GetName]的团队报告了令人警觉的消息：他们试图骇入我们的电脑系统，但是被发现了！幸运的是，我们可以在他们接触到任何敏感信息之前阻止他们。然而，这种不友好的行为让[Root.Owner.GetName]上的许多人对[From.Owner.GetName]可能造成的威胁忧心忡忡。
texts.en: Our team in charge of researching the [From.Owner.GetName] report alarming news: an attempt by them to hack into our computer systems has been detected! Fortunately, we were able to ward them off before they could get access to any sensitive information. However, this unfriendly act has left many within the [Root.Owner.GetName] deeply worried at the threat the [From.Owner.GetName] may pose.

texts.zh: 我们负责研究[From.Owner.GetName]的子个体报告了令人警觉的消息：他们试图骇入我们的电脑系统，但是被发现了！幸运的是，我们可以在他们接触到任何敏感信息之前阻止他们。我们应当对其保持警惕，并且提防他们未来的可能对[This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]不利的一举一动。
texts.en: Our drones in charge of researching the [From.Owner.GetName] report alarming news: an attempt by them to hack into our computer systems has been detected! Fortunately, we were able to ward them off before they could get access to any sensitive information. We should be watchful of them, and be wary of any future moves they may make that could be detrimental to the [This.Owner.GetGovernmentName].

texts.zh: 我们负责研究[From.Owner.GetName]的无人机报告了令人警觉的消息：他们试图骇入我们的电脑系统，但是被发现了！幸运的是，我们可以在他们接触到任何敏感信息之前阻止他们。这一事件提醒我们升级防御措施和移动系统的固件，并且提高我们对[From.Owner.GetName]的威胁估值。
texts.en: Our drones in charge of researching the [From.Owner.GetName] report alarming news: an attempt by them to hack into our systems has been detected! Fortunately, we were able to ward them off before they could get access to any sensitive information. This occurrence has prompted us to update our defense protocols and mobile systems' firmware - and to upgrade our threat rating of the [From.Owner.GetName].

label.zh: 我们要小心点盯着他们。
label.en: We will have to be watchful of them.
